title: Use cases: documentation, support, legal and internal knowledge bases

videos.script: Four teams want the same thing: answers from their own documents. {{four}} The engineers want their API reference. They ask about an error code, and the search brings back the wrong row of the table. {{code}} To an embedding model, two codes that differ by one digit look the same. {{grep}} Support wants the help centre. The questions come in the customer's words, sometimes in Portuguese. {{support}} Legal wants the terms of sale. The answer has to be the clause itself, with its number, in the version that applied. {{legal}} And everybody wants the internal handbooks. Ask an innocent question from a support desk, and out comes a threshold the finance team asked to keep private. {{leak}} Same pipeline, four different ways to be wrong. {{table}} Last, the questions that should never reach a retrieval system at all. A count. A list of everything. The status of an order right now. {{wrong}} Knowing which is which is half of building one. {{end}}
